(MTS Non Tech Havaldar CBIC and CBN Examination 2024)
options: Fall
Side
Jump
Surprise
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Fall

Collapse - Fall

Explanation:
"Collapse" means to fall down suddenly, often due to weakness or lack of support. "Fall" is the most appropriate synonym as it conveys a similar meaning of dropping or giving way.
"Collapse" का अर्थ है अचानक गिर जाना, अक्सर कमजोरी या सहारे की कमी के कारण। "Fall" सबसे उपयुक्त समानार्थी है क्योंकि यह गिरने या ढहने का समान अर्थ देता है।

Other synonyms Words:
Crumble, Topple, Sink, Break down, Give way

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Collapse – ढहना – To fall down suddenly
Example: "The old building collapsed after the earthquake."

Side – किनारा – A position to the left or right of an object
Example: "He stood by my side during the difficult times."

Jump – कूदना – To push oneself off the ground into the air
Example: "The athlete can jump very high."

Surprise – आश्चर्य – An unexpected event
Example: "Her sudden visit was a pleasant surprise."

Fall – गिरना – To drop or descend under force of gravity
Example: "The leaves fall from the trees in autumn."

Conclusion:
"Fall" is the best synonym for "collapse" as both imply a sudden downward movement, whereas the other options do not convey the same meaning.

question:

(CHSL Exam 2023 Tier I)
options: Co-worker
Distend
Exempt
Consult
solution:

Explanation:

सहकर्मी (Colleague) का अर्थ है किसी के साथ काम करने वाला व्यक्ति, आमतौर पर पेशेवर सेटिंग में। "Co-worker" सबसे उपयुक्त पर्यायवाची है क्योंकि इसका अर्थ भी आपके साथ काम करने वाला व्यक्ति होता है।

Other synonyms Words:
Associate, Partner, Fellow worker, Team member, Collaborator

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Colleague – सहकर्मी – A person with whom one works in a profession or business.
Example: "My colleague helped me finish the project on time."

Distend – फूलना – To swell or expand due to internal pressure.
Example: "The balloon distended as it filled with air."

Exempt – छूट देना – Free from an obligation or liability imposed on others.
Example: "Students with good grades were exempt from the final exam."

Consult – परामर्श लेना – Seek information or advice from someone.
Example: "I will consult my lawyer before signing the contract."

Co-worker – सहकर्मी – A person who works with another in the same workplace.
Example: "My co-worker and I share the same office."

Conclusion:
"Co-worker" is the best synonym for "colleague" because both refer to someone who works alongside you in a professional environment, while the other options do not fit the context.

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Colloquial
(Constable GD Examination 2022)
options: Conversational
Lexical
Linguistic
Prosodic
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Conversational

Colloquial - Conversational

Explanation:
"Colloquial" refers to language used in ordinary or informal conversation rather than formal writing or speech. "Conversational" is the best synonym as it also denotes informal, everyday language.
"Colloquial" का अर्थ है आम बोलचाल की भाषा, जो औपचारिक लेखन या भाषण के बजाय सामान्य वार्तालाप में प्रयुक्त होती है। "Conversational" इसका सबसे उपयुक्त पर्याय है क्योंकि यह भी अनौपचारिक, रोज़मर्रा की भाषा को दर्शाता है।

Other synonyms Words:
informal, casual, vernacular, everyday, familiar

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Colloquial – बोलचाल की भाषा – (Language used in ordinary or informal conversation)
Example: "The book is written in a colloquial style to make it more relatable."

Lexical – शब्दावली संबंधी – (Relating to the words or vocabulary of a language)
Example: "The lexical differences between British and American English are fascinating."

Linguistic – भाषाई – (Relating to language or linguistics)
Example: "She has a deep interest in linguistic studies."

Prosodic – छंद संबंधी – (Relating to the rhythm, stress, and intonation of speech)
Example: "The poet paid great attention to the prosodic elements of his verses."

Conversational – वार्तालापिक – (Informal, resembling everyday speech)
Example: "His writing has a conversational tone that engages readers easily."

Conclusion:
"Conversational" is the best synonym for "colloquial" because both describe informal, everyday language used in casual communication. The other options either relate to broader linguistic concepts or formal aspects of language, making them unsuitable as direct synonyms.

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym for the underlined word in the given sentence.
A colossal amount of money has been wasted on the construction of a new administrative building.
(CHSL Exam 2023 Tier I)
options: miniature
micro
small
huge
solution:

Explanation:
The word "colossal" means extremely large or huge. Among the given options, "huge" is the most appropriate synonym.
विशाल शब्द का अर्थ है बहुत बड़ा या विशाल। दिए गए विकल्पों में, "huge" सबसे उपयुक्त समानार्थी शब्द है।

colossal – विशाल – extremely large
Example: "A colossal statue was erected in the city center."

miniature – लघु – very small in size
Example: "She collects miniature dolls."

micro – अति सूक्ष्म – extremely small
Example: "The device uses micro technology."

small – छोटा – not large in size
Example: "He lives in a small apartment."

huge – विशाल – extremely large
Example: "They spent a huge amount of money on the project."

Conclusion:
The correct answer is "huge" because it best captures the meaning of "colossal" (extremely large), while the other options suggest smallness, making them incorrect.

options: Pretty
Prudent
Nosey

solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Pretty

Comely - Pretty

Explanation:
"Comely" means attractive or pleasant in appearance, and "Pretty" is the closest synonym as it also refers to something or someone that is visually pleasing.
"Comely" का अर्थ है आकर्षक या सुंदर, और "Pretty" इसका सबसे नजदीकी समानार्थी शब्द है क्योंकि यह भी किसी सुंदर या आकर्षक व्यक्ति या वस्तु को दर्शाता है।

Other synonyms Words:
Beautiful, Attractive, Lovely, Charming, Graceful

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Comely – सुंदर – Pleasing in appearance; attractive.
Example: "She had a comely face that caught everyone's attention."

Prudent – समझदार – Acting with or showing care for the future.
Example: "It would be prudent to save money for emergencies."

Nosey – जिज्ञासु – Excessively curious about others' affairs.
Example: "Our neighbor is very nosey and always asks personal questions."

Cruel – क्रूर – Willfully causing pain or suffering to others.
Example: "The cruel king punished innocent people for no reason."

Pretty – सुंदर – Attractive in a delicate way.
Example: "She wore a pretty dress to the party."

Conclusion:
"Pretty" is the best synonym for "Comely" because both words describe attractiveness, whereas the other options do not relate to appearance. "Prudent," "Nosey," and "Cruel" have entirely different meanings.

question:

Stream
Class
Bank

Example: "The city flourished due to its thriving commerce."

Stream – धारा – A small, narrow river or a continuous flow of something.
Example: "A clear stream flowed through the valley."

Class – वर्ग – A group of students or a category based on shared characteristics.
Example: "She attended a yoga class in the morning."

Bank – बैंक – A financial institution that accepts deposits and lends money.
Example: "He deposited his savings in the bank."

Trade – व्यापार – The action of buying and selling goods and services.
Example: "International trade has boosted the country's economy."

Conclusion:
"Trade" is the most appropriate synonym for "commerce" as both involve economic transactions, whereas the other options (stream, class, bank) are unrelated to buying and selling activities.

solution:

Explanation:
"Compel" means to force someone to do something, and "obligate" also means to bind or compel someone legally or morally. Both words imply a sense of duty or necessity.
"Compel" का अर्थ है किसी को कुछ करने के लिए मजबूर करना, और "obligate" का अर्थ भी किसी को कानूनी या नैतिक रूप से बाध्य करना है। दोनों शब्द कर्तव्य या आवश्यकता का भाव व्यक्त करते हैं।

Other synonyms Words:
Force, Coerce, Constrain, Pressure, Drive

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Compel – मजबूर करना – To force someone to do something.
Example: "The law can compel companies to disclose their financial records."

Allow – अनुमति देना – To permit someone to do something.
Example: "The teacher will allow students to leave early today."

Stop – रोकना – To cause something to come to an end.
Example: "Please stop making noise during the lecture."

Give – देना – To freely transfer something to someone.
Example: "She decided to give her old books to charity."

Obligate – बाध्य करना – To bind someone legally or morally.
Example: "The contract obligates the company to pay the workers on time."

Conclusion:
"Obligate" is the best synonym for "compel" because both imply forcing someone to act due to duty or necessity, whereas the other options do not convey the same meaning.

solution:

Example: "He felt no compunction about lying to his boss."

Grief – दुःख – Intense sorrow, especially caused by someone's death.
Example: "She was overcome with grief after her father's passing."

Example: "She had no scruples about cheating in the exam."

Conclusion:
"Scruples" is the best synonym for "Compunction" because both words refer to moral hesitation or guilt about wrongdoing, while the other options do not convey the same meaning.

solution:

Other synonyms Words:
Mask, Cover, Bury, Suppress, Shield

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Conceal – छिपाना – To keep something secret or prevent it from being seen.
Example: "He tried to conceal his disappointment with a smile."

Reveal – प्रकट करना – To make something known that was previously hidden.
Example: "The investigation revealed new evidence."

Discover – खोजना – To find something unexpectedly or through search.
Example: "Scientists discovered a new species in the rainforest."

Erase – मिटाना – To remove something completely.
Example: "She erased the wrong answer and wrote the correct one."

Hide – छिपाना – To put or keep out of sight.
Example: "The cat likes to hide under the bed."

Conclusion:
"Hide" is the best synonym for "conceal" because both words mean keeping something out of sight or secret. The other options either mean the opposite (reveal, discover) or are unrelated (erase).
